$comment: ARC Framework changelog — bundled with the npm package, displayed during `arc update`.
Add an entry for each published version. Fields:
highlights[] — user-visible changes (1-5 bullet points, concise)
breaking[]   — breaking changes requiring adopter action (empty array if none)
migrationNotes? — optional one-liner with migration guidance
Entries are filtered by semver range during update — only versions between the
adopter's installed version and the new version are shown. Keep entries short;
adopters see them in the terminal, not a web page.

highlights: Initial development version — not published to npm
